markscheme.marking_summary: Exact original MS leaf excerpt: Award [5 max] Data must be modelled knowing the purpose otherwise the data will not do what is required; Identify the entities/tables; If incorrect they will not support the purpose of the DB; The attributes of the tables should be necessary and sufficient for purpose; Otherwise may get inefficiencies; The keys for accessing the tables need to be identified; Otherwise the user cannot access the data; Identify the relationships among tables; Otherwise the user cannot perform complex queries across several tables; Identify relationships and normalization that reduces data duplication;

(c) Award [5 max]
Data must be modelled knowing the purpose otherwise the data will not do what is required;
Identify the entities/tables;
If incorrect they will not support the purpose of the DB;
The attributes of the tables should be necessary and sufficient for purpose;
Otherwise may get inefficiencies;
The keys for accessing the tables need to be identified;
Otherwise the user cannot access the data;
Identify the relationships among tables;
Otherwise the user cannot perform complex queries across several tables;
Identify relationships and normalization that reduces data duplication;
